JD Vance Comments on Watergate Scandal's Modern Media Impact

JD Vance stated that the Watergate scandal, which led to Richard Nixon's resignation, would be a '12-hour news story' if it occurred today. He described it as "crazy" that the scandal brought down a presidency. These comments reflect on the perceived change in media cycles and public attention over time.
